declared_policy_differences.scope: successful Stable login bootstrap packet ordering and server-branded packets
declared_policy_differences.reference: includes its welcome notification, menu icon and configured channel ordering
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: returns Zigcho's own channels and omits bancho.py branding
declared_policy_differences.reason: the client contract requires a coherent bootstrap, not another server's branding; critical protocol, identity, privileges, presence, stats, channel-end and friends packets stay pinned per target

declared_policy_differences.scope: malformed Stable login and packet framing
declared_policy_differences.reference: lets parser exceptions escape as HTTP 500 and accepts the oversized zero-payload ping declaration
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: rejects the same malformed cases without an internal-server response
declared_policy_differences.reason: safe rejection is intentional and more compatible with a bounded public protocol surface than reproducing reference crashes

declared_policy_differences.scope: a second Stable login less than ten seconds after an active poll
declared_policy_differences.reference: rejects the second login and keeps the first session
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: atomically replaces the first session and returns a new owned token
declared_policy_differences.reason: Zigcho enforces one cross-client session through explicit takeover instead of waiting for idle expiry

declared_policy_differences.reference: drops the message without a response packet
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: returns silence_end with the remaining duration
declared_policy_differences.reason: Zigcho gives the client an immediate visible silence timer

declared_policy_differences.scope: entering and leaving the Stable multiplayer lobby
declared_policy_differences.reference: tracks lobby visibility and match listings without opening a channel
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: also opens and closes #lobby so the client has the requested visible lobby channel
declared_policy_differences.reason: Zigcho deliberately exposes #lobby while preserving the reference match-list lifecycle

declared_policy_differences.scope: Stable packet 98 requesting the visible presence bundle
declared_policy_differences.reference: iterates a set of unrestricted players, shadows the requester variable and enqueues the bundle onto the nondeterministic final member; the requester's live response body cannot prove which member received it
declared_policy_differences.zigcho: returns the presence bundle to the requesting session
declared_policy_differences.reason: complete mode statically attests the exact pinned reference defect, then runtime validates Zigcho's complete requester bundle without pretending the reference recipient is deterministic
